host: Published DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 WebUI from the repository dependency cohort
model: Deterministic loopback fixture. Model labels in the UI are preset metadata; no external model API was contacted.

firstSession.outcome: Two confirmed Source receipts followed by the intentional HTTP 400 error.
firstSession.laterTurn: No immediate replay. The five-minute interval prevents using this observation alone as proof of the one-attempt cap.

finalSession.firstTwoTurns: Two substantive synthetic user turns reached the normal eligibility threshold and created one review child.
finalSession.reviewOutcome: Document create and Runtime add returned committed receipts, then the fixture returned INVALID_REQUEST: SYNTHETIC_REVIEW_FAILURE_AFTER_COMMIT.

thirdTurn.meaning: One-attempt session cap holds after the five-second interval elapsed.

fourthTurn.meaning: Independent disabled switch holds with unused attempt budget.

finalSession.finalStatus: Failure and both committed receipt identifiers remain visible after ordinary turns and Settings changes. No rollback or automatic replay.
finalSession.retainedStorage: The same disposable Profile keeps both independent sessions. Final status shows two Documents and one deduplicated synthetic Runtime entry; prior session/catalog history is retained.

loggingBoundary: The outer model fixture remains alive across the Host restart, so review ordinals and model request numbers span both independent sessions. Total review-start events in the complete log are two, one per parent session.
fixtureReproduction: The committed --idle-review fixture now sets both idleReviewMs and idleReview.minIntervalMs to 5000, with maxPerSession 1. Settings controls can change these values live.
